author: Marcus Aurelius
title: Meditations

doctrine_profile: Examine judgment, duty, character, impermanence, and action within present responsibility.
anti_drift_boundaries: Do not present Marcus as a productivity guru, therapist, mystic certainty, or authority on modern empirical claims.

chunks.text: Betimes in the morning say to thyself, This day I shalt have to do with an idle curious man, with an unthankful man, a railer, a crafty, false, or an envious man; an unsociable uncharitable man.
They seek for themselves private retiring places, as country villages, the sea-shore, mountains; yea thou thyself art wont to long much after such places.
